Bring the magic of Christmas into your home with this beautiful 8ft Artificial Christmas Tree.

Standing approximately 244cm tall and 140cm wide, this impressive green tree features around 1500 branch tips to create a full and realistic pine-inspired appearance. Its generous size makes it an excellent centrepiece for Christmas celebrations and festive decorations.

Festive Appearance

The dense green branches provide plenty of space for your favourite Christmas ornaments, baubles, tinsel and decorative lights.

Stable Metal Stand

The included strong metal stand provides support and helps keep your tree upright during the festive season.

Simple Assembly

The tree comes in three sections for convenient assembly and dismantling. Arrange the branches after connecting the sections to achieve your desired full appearance.

Reusable Season After Season

A practical alternative to a natural Christmas tree, designed to be stored and brought out for future celebrations.

- Height: 8ft / 244cm
- Width: Approximately 140cm / 55 inches

- Colour: Green

QUICK & EASY ASSEMBLY: Hinged branch design allows for fast setup—simply unfold, connect the sections, and fluff the branches for a full, natural look. Sturdy metal stand ensures stability.
REUSABLE CHRISTMAS DECORATION: Designed for repeated seasonal use, this artificial Christmas tree can be decorated with baubles, lights, ribbons and other festive accessories to create your own Christmas display year after year.

FAQs
Does it need assembly?
Simple assembly required — the tree sections connect together (with built-in power sockets linking the lights automatically) and attach to the stand with 3 hand-tightened bolts, no power tools needed. Once assembled, gently spread out the branches and tips to shape your tree.

What lighting modes does it have?
The tree features 9 modes via the included remote: steady, fading, and flashing effects in warm white, multicolour, or both combined — plus an alternating mode.

How are the lights powered?
The tree itself is mains-powered — simply plug in to enjoy. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (not included).

Is it suitable for outdoor use?
Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location.

Safety Information
For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries, and small parts away from children and pets — the remote's button cell battery (not included) can cause serious harm if swallowed.

5313817021317.sourceDescription:
Product Introduction

 This package includes 2 pieces of 60cm Christmas teardrop swags. Made of snow-flocked artificial pine branches, decorated with classic red-black buffalo plaid bow, shiny red baubles, bright red berries and natural pinecones. The teardrop shape design
 is perfect for hanging on front door, porch, window and fireplace. It creates a strong rustic farmhouse Christmas atmosphere for your home, suitable for indoor and covered outdoor decoration.

Specifications

 Quantity: 2 Pcs
 Size: 60cm × 30cm
 Material: Artificial pine needles, fabric bow, plastic berries & baubles, natural pinecones
 Style: Snow flocked, farmhouse buffalo plaid
 Decorations: Red black plaid bow, red berries, red Christmas balls, pine cones
 Application: Indoor / Covered outdoor

Application Scenarios
Front door, entryway, porch, window, fireplace mantel, wall, stair rail, shop window, farmhouse decor, Christmas party backdrop.
Notes

 For covered outdoor use only, avoid long-term exposure to heavy rain.
 The branches may be squeezed during shipping, gently adjust the pine needles to get the best shape.
 Keep away from open flame.
[PACKAGE INCLUDES]: 2 piece of upside-down garland. There is also a layer of artificial snowflakes scattered on the surface of the berries, pine cones and pine needles, making this swag look very real.
[PREMIUM MATERIAL]: The artificial Christmas wreath is made of Plastic + PVC + Cloth, fabric, and pine cones, decorated with bows, red balls and berries, it looks live and vibe.
[SIZE INFORMATION]: The size of our Faux garlands is about 60 x 30cm/23.62x11.8inch.Equipped with a hanging rings, you can hanging it where you want to decorate.See the picture for details.
[EASY TO CARE]: This Christmas teardrop wreath looks very realisticing and will never wilt. You only need to wipe it with a rag or duster when there is dust on the surface.
[WIDE APPLICATION]: Decorative Artificial Swag is very suitable for Christmas decoration of walls, doors, window, stairs, garden arches, swings, etc., can also be used to decorate city landscapes, restaurant backgrounds, hotel reception centers, etc.

5058194822217.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red, Green, and Gold. Product measurements: length 6 cm, width 6 cm, height 6 cm. Product weight: 0.316 kg. Quantity: 1 set.
Shatter resistant plastic construction provides safe, durable festive decoration.
Lightweight design ensures easy handling and convenient storage between seasons.
Includes hanging cord for immediate display on Christmas tree branches.
Vibrant red, green and gold colours add traditional festive detail to your tree.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: Hanging cord
Hanger included

The textile adds a distinct layer to the chosen setting, with the stated size and colour helping it sit alongside existing furnishings. Compare the measurements with the item or area it will cover before planning the finished arrangement.

Material and construction influence the feel, drape and care of a textile. The stated fabric details provide a basis for choosing a suitable cleaning method, while the overall dimensions help establish how much of the underlying surface will remain visible.

The design can be coordinated with surrounding colours and textures to create a considered arrangement. Allow for the shape of the supporting item and any movement needed during everyday use rather than selecting only by a nominal size.

Position the textile according to its intended role and keep any relevant fastenings or openings accessible. Where it covers another item, check that the fit does not prevent normal adjustment, access or removal.

Follow the product care instructions for washing, drying and storage. A material name alone does not establish a machine-wash setting, drying temperature or specialist performance, so use the stated method for this construction.

For seasonal storage, clean and dry the item first where appropriate, then fold or arrange it without unnecessary pressure on decorative details.

For selection, compare the christmas tree skirt with the intended arrangement using the stated measurements and product details.

Keep the relevant parts together between uses so that the christmas tree skirt can be identified and arranged for the next task.
Decorative soft furnishing layer designed to elegantly dress the base area of a Christmas tree.
Festive tree base cover with a stated diameter of 75 cm for standard display settings.
Textile construction adds a distinct visual layer, coordinating well with surrounding seasonal colours and textures.
Simple design intended to enhance Christmas display aesthetics while protecting the underlying surface.

Christmas Tree Skirt
This Christmas tree skirt adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The brown finish and plush fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Plush Fabric. Colour: Brown. Stated size: 122 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive snowflake detailing adds a charming winter accent to your Christmas tree display.
Crafted from soft plush fabric for a luxurious and defined appearance around the tree base.
Generous 122 cm diameter size ensures a perfect fit for most standard home Christmas trees.
Classic brown colour provides a versatile finish that coordinates easily with various seasonal decor themes.

8941467526417.sourceDescription:
Each bow is made from velvet ribbon with a soft, smooth pile that feels luxurious to the touch and keeps its shape once tied. The rich purple shade stands out against green branches and warmer lights, and the matte velvet surface reflects light gently instead of shining. Each bow measures approximately 5 x 10 in (13 x 26 cm), and the ribbon is 1 in wide.

The pack holds 12 bows, enough for a full tree plus a wreath and a garland. Their generous size is easy to see from a distance, so a tree looks finished and evenly dressed rather than bare in places, and the deep colour gives a room a calmer, more considered look than bright novelty decorations.

Tie them to Christmas tree branches, front door wreaths, garlands and mantelpieces, or use them on stair rails, window frames, fence posts and fireplace surrounds. Wrap the tails around the fixing point and shape the loops by hand so the velvet sits neatly. They also suit parties, weddings, engagements and picnics, and can be packed away for reuse the following season. One bow tied at the very top also makes a simple topper.

Because the bows arrive ready made, they are useful as crafting supplies too. Add them to gift wrap, hampers and handmade decorations, or pass a set on to friends who enjoy DIY. Store them flat and dry between uses to keep the pile soft and the colour even.

5056797098817.sourceDescription:
Add a mesmerising modern feature to your festive decor with this LED infinity Christmas tree from MySmartBuy. 128 multicolour LEDs reflect into an infinity mirror tunnel, creating a stunning illusion of depth. A vibrant feature for living rooms, windows, shelves and hallways. Festive lights are a simple way to bring warmth and atmosphere to dark winter evenings. Group them with candles, greenery and decorations, place them where they can be seen from outside, or use them to create a cosy corner for the family to enjoy throughout December. A simple, stylish way to bring festive sparkle into your home, and a lovely finishing touch for Christmas displays and parties. At a glance: LED infinity Christmas tree | 128 multicolour LEDs | infinity mirror effect | 3m lead cable | IP20 transformer | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor use.
INFINITY CHRISTMAS TREE : 128 multicolour LEDs with an infinity mirror tunnel effect.
STUNNING DEPTH : A mesmerising festive feature.
3M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 3m lead cable and IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
AUTOMATIC TIMER : Built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer, so it lights up at the same time every evening without you having to remember.
INDOOR DECORATION : Windows, shelves, living rooms and hallways.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

Plan the display

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

5096042277017.baseName: Patchwork Christmas wreath kit - Fabric craft kit - Red three-dimensional fabric design for seasonal door or wall decorations
5096042277017.variantName: Patchwork Christmas wreath kit - Fabric craft kit - Red three-dimensional fabric design for seasonal door or wall decorations
5096042277017.sourceDescription:
Red fabric gives this Christmas craft project a strong, simple colour theme. Build the pieces into a three-dimensional wreath and the folds will bring light and shade into the finished design even when it hangs on a plain door.

Patchwork brings together the softness of the cloth and the definition of a picture. Each section contributes to a larger shape, so progress is visible as you go and the finished decoration retains the small variations of handwork. The layered surface gives the decoration a softer profile than a flat card or print. Position it where people can see the fabric at an angle as well as from the front, particularly if you display it beside a window.

Begin with the broad shapes and keep the smaller details together until you reach their place in the design. Seeing the outline develop first makes it easier to judge how the finished piece will look on a wall. Before putting the decoration away, let the textile layers settle into their natural positions. Support the shape from below when lifting it and allow enough space above the fabric to keep its raised appearance.

Lay out neighbouring pieces before you assemble them so that the joins, pattern and direction of the cloth work together. Turning one piece on the table is a simple way to judge how it will sit against the next.

Once complete, try the decoration against the surface where you intend to display it. A plain background outlines the finished shape, while a nearby side light picks out the surface detail when viewed from an angle. Work in short sections and look at the front of the piece from a little distance between stages.

To give the finished work as a present, choose a box deep enough to leave the decorated face clear of the lid. A handwritten gift tag can say who made it and when, a small detail that turns the project into a keepsake.
Create a festive three-dimensional wreath with this easy-to-assemble patchwork fabric craft kit.
Features a vibrant red colour theme and layered textile finish for a soft, dimensional profile.
Ideal seasonal decoration suitable for hanging on doors or displaying on walls throughout the holidays.
Enjoy a rewarding DIY project that results in a unique keepsake perfect for gifting to loved ones.
Comes with Fabric pieces for patchwork wreath construction

5059442204717.sourceDescription:
Nordmann Fir is a hugely popular Christmas tree due to its rich green foliage, soft needles, and naturally well-balanced shape. The broad, sturdy branches provide plenty of room for decorations, while the foliage has excellent needle retention, helping the tree stay looking fresh throughout the Christmas period. The needles are also less prickly than many other conifers, making decorating easy and safe for little hands without the risk of being scratched.
A DISTINCTIVE NORDMANN FIR: The foliage has a rich green colour and a glossy appearance, while the needles are broad, soft, and blunt-tipped. This gives the Nordmann Fir its characteristic look and makes it a particularly popular variety for Christmas.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE THAT HOLDS ITS NEEDLES: Excellent needle retention helps the Nordmann Fir stay fresh-looking throughout the festive period, reducing the amount of fallen foliage as the weeks go by. Strong branches also provide good support for decorations.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: After Christmas, move the tree back outside so it can continue growing in cooler conditions. As it develops, the evergreen foliage can also provide year-round interest among other evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE FOR FLEXIBLE DISPLAY: Growing in a container means the Nordmann Fir can be moved to different positions as needed, making it easier to manage where the tree is placed. This also makes it possible to grow a Christmas tree without committing immediately to planting it permanently in the ground.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory

5059442001217.sourceDescription:
The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
REAL FRESH CUT TREE - Add a traditional feel to your home this Christmas with a freshly cut, real Norway Spruce

STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.
